title: Install lockfile
description: Lockfile support (spec 10859). The lockfile pins the EXACT bytes that were certified: name, version, manifest digest and payload digest. Marketplace-first FM-2 measured 233 generated shims with no drift detector; a lockfile turns that drift into a hard install failure instead of a silent divergence. Frozen mode (`mkt install --frozen`) resolves ONLY from this file and refuses any package or digest the lockfile does not already contain.

index_digest.description: Digest of the index the lock was resolved against. A changed index with an unchanged lock is legal (that is the POINT of a lock) but it is recorded so a diverging registry is visible rather than inferred.

requested_by.description: `direct` or the name of the depending package. Makes a transitive dependency traceable to the root that pulled it in -- a lock whose entries have no provenance cannot be pruned safely.
